main_body: prehistoric palm/cycad tree with frond canopy and straight trunk
top_band: bright green central crown and upper frond surfaces on rows 1-10
evidence: The canopy shows a top-lit central crown/bud (rows 2-6) with radiating fronds seen from a 3/4 angle above the tall vertical trunk (rows 18-54), with dark foliage shading the top of the trunk.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, organic Beodeul reference trees with soft dark-green/brown outlines and varied leaf clusters, the candidate uses heavy near-black outlines around the central bud and fronds, symmetric repetitive trunk patterning, and a flatter, more rigid appearance.
